svg.title: Graph of the four seams: the entries each seam names
svg.desc: Each circle is an entry of the map and links to its page; the colour is the kind of body behind it, a filled circle is a core entry and a dashed circle a context entry. The four seams S1 to S4 are drawn with the entries that notes/seams.md names for each.
svg.text: Agentic standards map: the entries named by each seam
